results.snippet: The SECURE Act creates a new form of plan — PEPs, which do not apply to ARPs or “open” or “closed” MEPs, including professional employer organization (PEO) MEPs. Existing MEPs will not be considered PEPs unless they have a PPP, elect to be a PEP and satisfy all other requirements. Guidance on whether (and how) an existing MEP could be converted into a PEP would be helpful.
